odel servers, fact checks, cited reports, optional real-browser laptop MCP
# dsh-deep-research

**A deep-research swarm for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that runs
entirely on your own GPUs.** You type `

/deep-research <question>`. An orchestrator scopes the question and plans
5–10 non-overlapping sub-q

uestions. It then fans out researcher subagents over every model server you have. They
search, read
pages and PDFs in full, look at YouTube videos frame by frame, and write notes with verbatim quotes.
A critic finds the gaps and starts another round. Independent fact-checkers re-verify the key claim

s against
primary sources. A writer turns it all into a cited report, and the critic reviews that re

port until it holds up.
An optional **laptop MCP** sends the pages plain fetching can't get (bot wal

ls, JavaScript apps, login-only forums)
to a real Chrome on a spare Windows PC.
It is built for the hardware people actually own: **one model, a mixture-of-experts with the experts

in system
RAM, on ordinary consumer cards.** With ~16 GB of VRAM and 64–128 GB of RAM you get ~70 t

ok/s and a 256K context
per box. A 10 GB RTX 3080 with 64 GB of RAM does ~55 tok/s at 224K. Two such
boxes ran every run below.
| Run (Nov 2026, two consumer PCs) | wall clock | subagents | tool calls | report | sources cited |
| Board-level repair of a ZOTAC RTX 3060 Ti (report) | 7.8 h | 41 (34 research/fact-check, 4 browser

passes, 2 critic, 1 writer) | 1,692 | 14,560 words | 169 |
| What mobile game should a solo dev bui
ld in late 2026 | 4.6 h | 37 (3 rounds, 21 fact checks, 2 browser passes) | 1,448 | 9,173 words | 16

8 |
| DDR4-3200 Gear 1 tuning on a B560 board | 1.6 h | 11 | 455 | 5,199 words | 49 |
| ROCm 7.2 on
consumer Radeons (**one server**: everything on the 16 GB box) | 2.2 h | 9 | 495 | 3,281 words | 56
onsumer Radeons (**one server**: everything on the 16 GB box) | 2.2 h | 9 | 495 | 3,281 words | 56 |
[该节后续省略]
## Why it works on a local model
- **The bulk lives in files, not in context.** Every worker appends findings to its own notes file a

s it goes, so
compaction and crashes lose nothing. The orchestrator's own context stays small: plan,

queue, verdicts.
- **Lanes, not a free-for-all.** Each server becomes a `research_<server>` delegat

ion tool, and the skill keeps a
fixed number of subagents on each (2 per server here). With `--paral

lel 1` an MoE gains nothing from batching.
A server that keeps idle conversations in RAM switches be

tween two subagents in ~1 s instead of re-reading 50K
tokens.
- **Workers compact early** (at 20% of

the window), so two worker contexts fit each server's conversation cache.
The compaction engine is

replaced with one whose checkpoint is bounded by construction. The stock one
deadlocks long sessions

on this model class.
- **Evidence rules a small model can follow:** quote verbatim or it isn't a fi

nding; a page you couldn't load
isn't a source; what a video *shows* needs frames you looked at, not

its title; numbers need a source that states
them; contradicted fact checks never appear as fact.
-
**Search that is good and cheap:** Exa → DuckDuckGo → other free engines, chosen by a blind evaluat

ion
(SEARCH). A whole run costs about $0.30 of Exa credit, and every engine but Exa needs no key.
## Install: ask your agent
There are many home-lab layouts (one GPU box or five, llama.cpp or a fork or vLLM, systemd or not, a

cloud route
on the side), and an install script can't be tested against all of them. **The recommen

ded install is to point a
coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, dsh itself, ...) at this repo:**
> Read `AGENTS.md` in this repo and set up dsh-deep-research for my lab. My model servers are … (or:
TS.md` in this repo and set up dsh-deep-research for my lab. My model servers are … (or: find them).
`AGENTS.md` is written for that agent. It surveys your machine and servers, picks a layout with you,
runs the wizard, adapts whatever the wizard doesn't cover, and does a first smoke run.
**If your setup is common** (dsh already installed, OpenAI-compatible servers, a Qwen-style reasonin

g model), the
wizard does it directly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It creates a **separate dsh profile** (`research` by default), so your existing profiles stay untouc

hed. Then open
the web UI, start a session on the **Deep research** preset, and type `/deep-research

n
the web UI, start a session on the **Deep research** preset, and type `/deep-research <question>`.

Requirements: dsh (tested on **0.2.1-rc.5**), Python 3.10+,
uv (the page reader, frames and search h

elpers are self-contained uv scripts) and
`zstd`. You also need one or more OpenAI-compatible model

servers with tool calling and ≥ 64K context; 128K+ is
better. docs/INFERENCE.md covers models, engin

l calling and ≥ 64K context; 128K+ is
better. docs/INFERENCE.md covers models, engines and settings.
## What's here

| `AGENTS.md` | the install-and-adapt guide, written for an agent |
| `docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md` | the p

ipeline, the five agent presets, lanes, compaction, how it maps onto dsh |
| `docs/LAYOUT.md` | the

layout file; 1, 2 or N servers; lanes and concurrency; cloud routes |
| `docs/INFERENCE.md` | what t

he model servers need, and settings that matter |
| `docs/SEARCH.md` | search engines, keys, and the

blind evaluation behind their order |
| `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` | the failures that cost us whole

runs, and their fixes |
| `docs/reference-lab/` | **a real setup that works**: the two boxes, engin

es, models, flags, dsh config, numbers |
| `skill/deep-research/` | the `/deep-research` skill (a te

mplate the wizard renders) and its helpers: `fetch`, `frames`, `search` |
| `presets/personas/` | th

e orchestrator, worker, critic, writer and laptop-reader prompts |
| `plugin/bounded-compaction.mjs`

| the compaction engine every preset mounts |
| `wizard/` | `setup.py` and example layouts |
| `lap

top-mcp/` | optional: a real Chrome on a Windows PC as an MCP server, one agent at a time |
| `tools

/run_stats.py` | stats and the swarm timeline above, for your own runs |
| `examples/` | one complet
e run's plan, fact checks and report |
## Status
This is a working personal setup made reusable, not a product. It is tied to dsh's preview APIs: age

nt presets,
`dsh-tool-subagent`, and the compaction engine's subclass hook. Expect to re-check it af

ter dsh upgrades
